newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran says recoverable oil reserve at 88 billion.
newsitem.headline: Iran says recoverable oil reserve at 88 billion.

text.p: Iran's recoverable oil reserves stand at 88 billion barrels, the head of exploration at the national Iranian oil company said in a newspaper interview.
In the interview with the newspaper Iran, Mahdi Husseini said that "between one and two billion barrels could be extracted during the (country's) second five-year development plan" from 1995 to 1999.
As reported by the official Iranian news agency IRNA on Saturday, said that between 707 and 1,414 billion cubic metres of natural gas were expected to be discovered over the same period.
IRNA did not indicate whether the interview appeared in Saturday or Sunday's edition of the paper.

Husseini also said a relatively large oil field with a reserve of 1.5 billion barrels of oil as well as gas reserves of 226 to 282 billion cubic metres recently had been discovered. He did not give further details.
